Architectural decisions (choices that change the model structure):

Cell type: LSTM vs GRU vs vanilla RNN

Direction: unidirectional vs bidirectional
Number of layers: 1, 2, 3
Hidden state size: 128, 256, 512

How to pool the sequence: last hidden state vs attention vs mean of all hidden states !

How to encode the inputs: separate encoding vs concatenated sequence with SEP tokens !

How to combine the encoded pieces: concat, element-wise difference, cosine similarity !

Classifier head on top: single linear layer vs MLP with ReLU !

Hyperparameters (values you tune without changing architecture):

Learning rate
Batch size
Number of epochs
Dropout rate (on embeddings, between RNN layers, before classifier)
Gradient clipping threshold
Optimizer choice (Adam, AdamW, SGD)
Weight decay (L2 regularization)
Hidden dimension
Embedding dimension (if training your own)
Early stopping patience
